name: mutL homolog 1

function.text: MLH1 encodes a DNA mismatch-repair protein that forms the MutLα complex with PMS2, helping correct replication-associated mismatches and insertion/deletion errors.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Lynch syndrome (autosomal dominant); Constitutional mismatch repair deficiency (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Loss of mismatch-repair function involving MLH1 is relevant in colorectal and endometrial carcinomas. Protein-expression loss or an MSI phenotype does not by itself establish a somatic sequence mutation. MLH1 promoter methylation is a distinct mechanism of tumor-associated silencing.
